title: Flow cytometry of sfGFP, mCherry and BFP expression from picked DNA-BOT colonies

steps.action: Using sterile tips or toothpicks, pick one individual colony from each construct's spot on the DNA-BOT agar plate into the matching well of ON1 (A1:H11, well position = construct position in the 88-construct layout). Pick a different colony for each of ON2 and ON3, giving three biological replicates per construct. Inoculate ON1/ON2/ON3 well A12 with the mScarlet-free p15A CmR backbone control strain; leave B12 uninoculated.
steps.source_quote: Individual colonies were picked from agar plates generated by DNA-BOT and 200 μl LB medium (ForMedium) supplemented with 25 µg/ml chloramphenicol inoculated in 96-well plates.
steps.note: Control strain in A12 and blank in B12 are assumed additions; triplicate colonies per construct are from the cited open-access article.

steps.action: Seal ON1, ON2 and ON3 with a breathable film or loose lid and incubate overnight (about 16-18 h) at 30 °C, shaking at 600 rpm.

steps.action: Acquire FC1, FC2 and FC3 on an Attune NxT Flow Cytometer from the 96-well plates, using the same forward/side scatter gating and instrument settings for all samples. Record sfGFP in BL1 (530/30, 488 nm laser), mCherry in YL2 (620/15, 561 nm laser) and mTagBFP in VL1 (440/50, 405 nm laser). Keep detector voltages identical for all plates, use a moderate flow rate (about 100-200 µl/min) and record about 10,000 gated events per well. Hold plates at 4 °C or room temperature until acquisition, keeping the hold time consistent. Export data to FlowJo V10 for gating (analysis not part of this protocol).
steps.source_quote: Samples were analyzed for sfGFP, BFP and mCherry fluorescence using an Attune NxT Flow Cytometer with all samples gated using the same forward and side scatter settings.
steps.note: Channels from Thermo Fisher Attune NxT fluorescent protein application note; voltages, flow rate and event count are standard practice, not stated in the paper.

assumptions: Layout: 88 constructs occupy A1:H11 of each plate (same position as in the DNA-BOT transformation/construct layout); well A12 holds the mScarlet-free p15A CmR backbone control strain (background control) and B12 an uninoculated medium blank. These controls are not stated in the paper and were added as standard practice; C12:H12 remain empty.

Three biological replicates are run as three separate plates (ON1-3, SUB1-3, FC1-3), each from a different picked colony per construct; the triplicate-colony design comes from the cited DNA-BOT open-access article (https://academic.oup.com/synbio/article/5/1/ysaa010/5869449).
Overnight culture duration assumed to be 16-18 h; plates sealed with breathable film or loose lid (standard practice).
The 1:200 dilution is implemented as 0.5 µl overnight culture into 99.5 µl LB-Cm (100 µl total), per standard practice and the gap assessment.
Shaking at 600 rpm assumed for the 6 h sub-culture (the paper states speed only for the overnight culture); post-transfer mixing of 3 cycles is assumed.
PBS with 2 mg/ml kanamycin is prepared fresh or from a filter-sterilised stock in a reservoir; hold time and temperature before acquisition are unspecified and should be kept consistent.

Flow cytometer channels (BL1 530/30 for sfGFP, YL2 620/15 for mCherry, VL1 440/50 for mTagBFP) are the manufacturer-recommended assignments from Thermo Fisher's Attune NxT fluorescent protein application note; the paper does not state them. The optional FP filter kit was not used.
Detector voltages, flow rate (about 100-200 µl/min), events per well (about 10,000) and the FSC/SSC bacterial gate drawn on a non-fluorescent control are standard practice, not stated in the paper.

LB-Cm volume requirement is about 82 mL (ON plates 3 × 90 wells × 200 µl plus sub-culture 3 × 90 × 99.5 µl), PBS-kan about 54 mL; both fit in one reservoir each (290 mL capacity). Reservoir stocks listed as ample (volume null).
Culture plates are 96-well plates with working volume of at least 202 µl, and the 202 µl final sample is read directly from the plate.
Data analysis (FlowJo V10 gating, background correction, normalisation, log-scaled plotting of means and SD) is deferred and not included in this protocol.
